clauses.clause: Live damage at cellar entry: ≥ 4 fires, ≥ 2 burning vehicles, ≥ 10 shattered windows, ≥ 6 scorch decals.
clauses.note: Both current low/high renderer worlds at actual cellar entry contain4 persistent fires,3 burned/burning vehicle identities,14 shattered-window events and21 live production Blasts.scorch pool instances (target≥6). Actual render and director tiers agree with each requested tier. Native ordinary route damage ledgers independently retain actual exploded/burned vehicle entities; collapse fire effects persist. The old s.scorch controller field is not the renderer count and is not used. Both new entry images were inspected; they frame the courtyard, so the remote damage census is supplied by the production state/pools and earlier151-frame full-route review.
